grammar.pattern: 动补式离合：打开 / 看见 / 离开 / 完成
grammar.purpose: Interpret inserted potential material and lexical limits
grammar.explanation: 打开 can contrast with 打不开; 看见 with 看得见/看不见; 离开 with 离不开, often a dependence meaning; 完成 with 完不成. These words are not noun-object compounds like 帮忙 and do not freely accept an object between their syllables. Read the complete construction, not just a separated character. 打不开门 describes inability to open it, not proof nobody tried.

zì tài xiǎo , wǒ kàn bú jiàn .
examples.en: The writing is too small for me to see.

examples.py: jīn tiān wán bù chéng , míng tiān jì xù .

commonMistakes.wrong: 我打开了，所以任务都完成了。
commonMistakes.right: 我打开了文件，但任务还没完成。
commonMistakes.why: Opening a file is distinct from finishing the task.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 到 / 住 / 走：结果
grammar.purpose: Identify achieved finding, retention or removal
grammar.explanation: 找文件 names searching; 找到文件 asserts successful finding. 记住 emphasizes retaining something, and 拿走 removes it from a location. 没找到 negates achieved finding, not necessarily the attempt. Do not treat all complements as interchangeable: 看到了 notices an object, 看懂了 understands its meaning.

commonMistakes.why: An attempted action does not guarantee the resulting achievement.

lines.zh: 你找到上次的活动文件了吗？
lines.py: nǐ zhǎo dào shàng cì de huó dòng wén jiàn le ma ?
lines.en: Have you found the file from our last event?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 找到了，在第一个文件夹里。
lines.py: zhǎo dào le , zài dì yī gè wén jiàn jiā lǐ .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 发给我看看，我想保留那张合照。
lines.py: fā gěi wǒ kàn kàn , wǒ xiǎng bǎo liú nà zhāng hé zhào .
lines.en: Send it over. I'd like to keep the group photo.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。还有通知，我整理一下再发。
lines.py: hǎo . hái yǒu tōng zhī , wǒ zhěng lǐ yī xià zài fā .
lines.en: Sure. There's a notice too. I'll sort it out and send it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 等等，标题写星期六，表格里却是星期日。
lines.py: děng děng , biāo tí xiě xīng qī liù , biǎo gé lǐ què shì xīng qī rì .
lines.en: Wait, the title says Saturday but the table says Sunday.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 啊，是我修改的时候漏了一处。
lines.py: a , shì wǒ xiū gǎi de shí hou lòu le yī chù .
lines.en: Oh, I missed one part when editing it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 具体改哪一页？
lines.py: jù tǐ gǎi nǎ yī yè ?
lines.en: Which page needs changing?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 第二页。我改好以后，把完整的文件发你。
lines.py: dì èr yè . wǒ gǎi hǎo yǐ hòu , bǎ wán zhěng de wén jiàn fā nǐ .
lines.en: The second. I'll send the complete file after fixing it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 原来那份也存着吧，下次还能用。
lines.py: yuán lái nà fèn yě cún zhe ba , xià cì hái néng yòng .
lines.en: Keep the original too. We might use it next time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。你现在就要吗？
lines.py: xíng . nǐ xiàn zài jiù yào ma ?
lines.en: Okay. Do you need it now?

lines.zh: 不急，六点以前给我就好。
lines.py: bù jí , liù diǎn yǐ qián gěi wǒ jiù hǎo .
lines.en: No rush. Before six is fine.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我先处理这一页，弄好就告诉你。
lines.py: nà wǒ xiān chǔ lǐ zhè yī yè , nòng hǎo jiù gào sù nǐ .
lines.en: I'll deal with this page and let you know when it's ready.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A careful file record
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我想找上次活动的合照，就问陈宇文件存在哪里。他说找到了，在第一个文件夹里，顺便把通知也发给我。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo shàng cì huó dòng de hé zhào , jiù wèn chén yǔ wén jiàn cún zài nǎ lǐ . tā shuō zhǎo dào le , zài dì yī gè wén jiàn jiā lǐ , shùn biàn bǎ tōng zhī yě fā gěi wǒ .
lines.en: I wanted the group photo from our last event and asked Chen Yu where he'd saved it. It was in the first folder, he said, and he sent the notice too.

lines.zh: 照片里六个人站得整整齐齐，只有我手上的杯子快要掉了。我想把照片保留下来，以后见面再给大家看。
lines.py: zhào piān lǐ liù gè rén zhàn de zhěng zhěng qí qí , zhǐ yǒu wǒ shǒu shàng de bēi zi kuài yào diào le . wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhào piān bǎo liú xià lái , yǐ hòu jiàn miàn zài gěi dà jiā kàn .
lines.en: The six of us stood neatly in the photo, except that the cup in my hand was about to fall. I wanted to keep it and show everyone when we met again.

lines.zh: 打开通知，我发现标题写星期六，第二页的表格却写星期日。我给陈宇发消息，他一下就想起来，上次只修改了标题。
lines.py: dǎ kāi tōng zhī , wǒ fā xiàn biāo tí xiě xīng qī liù , dì èr yè de biǎo gé què xiě xīng qī rì . wǒ gěi chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , tā yī xià jiù xiǎng qǐ lái , shàng cì zhǐ xiū gǎi le biāo tí .
lines.en: The notice title said Saturday, but the table on page two said Sunday. I messaged Chen Yu, who remembered he'd changed only the title last time.

lines.zh: 他问我具体什么时候要，我说六点以前就行。他先保留原件，再把第二页的日期改好，保存以后重新发来。
lines.py: tā wèn wǒ jù tǐ shén me shí hou yào , wǒ shuō liù diǎn yǐ qián jiù xíng . tā xiān bǎo liú yuán jiàn , zài bǎ dì èr yè de rì qī gǎi hǎo , bǎo cún yǐ hòu chóng xīn fā lái .
lines.en: He asked exactly when I needed it. Before six was fine. He kept the original, changed the date on page two, saved it and sent it again.

lines.zh: 这次文件一共三页，内容都在。我回了一句收到，又把合照单独存到照片里，免得下次还得找半天。
lines.py: zhè cì wén jiàn yī gòng sān yè , nèi róng dōu zài . wǒ huí le yī jù shōu dào , yòu bǎ hé zhào dān dú cún dào zhào piān lǐ , miǎn de xià cì hái děi zhǎo bàn tiān .
lines.en: The file now had all three pages. I replied that I'd received it and saved the group photo separately so I wouldn't spend ages looking next time.

lines.zh: 傍晚陈宇问我照片选好了没有。我说选好了，就是那张杯子快掉的。他笑我每次拍照，都要先给大家找点事做。
lines.py: bàng wǎn chén yǔ wèn wǒ zhào piān xuǎn hǎo le méi yǒu . wǒ shuō xuǎn hǎo le , jiù shì nà zhāng bēi zi kuài diào de . tā xiào wǒ měi cì pāi zhào , dōu yào xiān gěi dà jiā zhǎo diǎn shì zuò .
lines.en: That evening Chen Yu asked if I'd chosen a photo. I had: the one with the falling cup. He laughed that every time I posed I found something for everyone to do.

choices: The corrected file and a group photo

lines.en: The books are neatly arranged on the table.

lines.zh: 他穿得干净整齐。
lines.py: tā chuān de gān jìng zhěng qí .
lines.en: He's dressed cleanly and neatly.

lines.zh: 这本书是完整的，一页也没少。
lines.py: zhè běn shū shì wán zhěng de , yī yè yě méi shǎo .
lines.en: This book is complete, with no missing pages.

lines.zh: 请把完整的地址发给我。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ wán zhěng de dì zhǐ fā gěi wǒ .
lines.en: Please send me the full address.

lines.zh: 这份文件有三页。
lines.py: zhè fèn wén jiàn yǒu sān yè .
lines.en: This document has three pages.

lines.zh: 我把文件放进包里了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ wén jiàn fàng jìn bāo lǐ le .
lines.en: I put the document in my bag.

lines.zh: 请在表格上写名字。
lines.py: qǐng zài biǎo gé shàng xiě míng zi .
lines.en: Please write your name on the form.

lines.zh: 表格里还有一格没填。
lines.py: biǎo gé lǐ hái yǒu yī gé méi tián .
lines.en: There's still one blank field in the form.

lines.zh: 这个标题太长了。
lines.py: zhè gè biāo tí tài zhǎng le .
lines.en: This title is too long.

lines.zh: 我读完标题，就想继续看。
lines.py: wǒ dú wán biāo tí , jiù xiǎng jì xù kàn .
lines.en: The title made me want to read on.

lines.zh: 这本书的内容很有趣。
lines.py: zhè běn shū de nèi róng hěn yǒu qù .
lines.en: The contents of this book are interesting.

lines.zh: 她给我介绍了课程的内容。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ jiè shào le kè chéng de nèi róng .
lines.en: She introduced the course content to me.

lines.zh: 我每天记录开支。
lines.py: wǒ měi tiān jì lù kāi zhī .
lines.en: I record my spending every day.

lines.zh: 我们找到了去年旅行的记录。
lines.py: wǒ men zhǎo dào le qù nián lǚ xíng de jì lù .
lines.en: We found last year's travel records.

lines.zh: 照片是他到过这里的证据。
lines.py: zhào piān shì tā dào guò zhè lǐ de zhèng jù .
lines.en: The photo is evidence that he's been here.

lines.zh: 你说钱已经付了，有证据吗？
lines.py: nǐ shuō qián yǐ jīng fù le , yǒu zhèng jù ma ?
lines.en: You say you've paid. Do you have evidence?

lines.zh: 这张票可以证明我买过。
lines.py: zhè zhāng piào kě yǐ zhèng míng wǒ mǎi guò .
lines.en: This ticket can prove I bought it.

lines.zh: 我想用行动证明自己能做好。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng yòng xíng dòng zhèng míng zì jǐ néng zuò hǎo .
lines.en: I'd like to show through my actions that I can do it well.

lines.zh: 具体几点见？
lines.py: jù tǐ jǐ diǎn jiàn ?
lines.en: What exact time shall we meet?

lines.zh: 请说一个具体的例子。
lines.py: qǐng shuō yī gè jù tǐ de lì zi .
lines.en: Please give a specific example.

lines.zh: 他说得很明确，周四不能来。
lines.py: tā shuō de hěn míng què , zhōu sì bù néng lái .
lines.en: He was clear that he couldn't come on Thursday.

lines.zh: 这次分工很明确。
lines.py: zhè cì fēn gōng hěn míng què .
lines.en: The responsibilities are clear this time.

lines.zh: 我发现了一个错误。
lines.py: wǒ fā xiàn le yī gè cuò wù .
lines.en: I found a mistake.

lines.zh: 地址写错是我的错误。
lines.py: dì zhǐ xiě cuò shì wǒ de cuò wù .
lines.en: Writing the wrong address was my mistake.

lines.zh: 我修改了文章的最后一段。
lines.py: wǒ xiū gǎi le wén zhāng de zuì hòu yī duàn .
lines.en: I revised the final paragraph of the article.

lines.zh: 时间改了，通知也要修改。
lines.py: shí jiān gǎi le , tōng zhī yě yào xiū gǎi .
lines.en: The time has changed, so the notice needs revising too.

lines.zh: 门坏了，明天来修。
lines.py: mén huài le , míng tiān lái xiū .
lines.en: The door's broken. Someone will come to fix it tomorrow.

lines.zh: 他帮我修好了自行车。
lines.py: tā bāng wǒ xiū hǎo le zì xíng chē .
lines.en: He helped fix my bicycle.

lines.zh: 这件事我下午处理。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ xià wǔ chǔ lǐ .
lines.en: I'll deal with this this afternoon.

lines.zh: 我们先处理漏水的问题。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān chǔ lǐ lòu shuǐ de wèn tí .
lines.en: Let's deal with the leak first.

lines.zh: 问题已经解决了。
lines.py: wèn tí yǐ jīng jiě jué le .
lines.en: The problem has been solved.

lines.zh: 换一条路能解决堵车的问题吗？
lines.py: huàn yī tiáo lù néng jiě jué dǔ chē de wèn tí ma ?
lines.en: Would taking a different route solve the traffic problem?

lines.zh: 房间温度达到了二十度。
lines.py: fáng jiān wēn dù dá dào le èr shí dù .
lines.en: The room temperature reached twenty degrees.

lines.zh: 她终于达到了自己的目标。
lines.py: tā zhōng yú dá dào le zì jǐ de mù biāo .
lines.en: She finally reached her goal.

lines.zh: 电影九点结束。
lines.py: diàn yǐng jiǔ diǎn jié shù .
lines.en: The film ends at nine.

lines.zh: 会议结束以后，我们一起吃饭。
lines.py: huì yì jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ men yì qǐ chī fàn .
lines.en: We had a meal together after the meeting.

audio.zh: 第二页。我改好以后，把完整的文件发你。
audio.py: dì èr yè . wǒ gǎi hǎo yǐ hòu , bǎ wán zhěng de wén jiàn fā nǐ .
audio.en: The second. I'll send the complete file after fixing it.

2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Naturalness correction: finding a group photo and fixing a date, preparing dinner for four, supplying a six-person reading group, and practising a song before a concert. Replaced assessment-policy lectures, lexical analysis inside conversations and robotic examples with independently authored situations. All 88 word records have two different notebook contexts. Original IDs and grammar evidence remain. Self-review: exact four-person dinner seating and three invited guests; two groups of three; two missing sheets; page two and before-six deadline; concert doors at seven, start at eight, station at six thirty. False listening statements contradict their own heard line. Native flags: bound 富/整 senses, classifiers 行/架/支/只, 相当 equivalent versus fairly, 比较 compare versus relatively, 证明 evidence examples, emphatic 倒是 and pretend-microphone teasing.
